title: Integration Testing + Optimization Benchmarking + Skills + Hooks
description: End-to-end integration testing of the complete 35-stage pipeline across multiple machine/material/operation combinations. Benchmark optimization quality against constant S/F baseline and commercial post processors. Create slash commands for post processor interaction. Build hooks for auto-triggering. Create comprehensive documentation.

units.title: End-to-end pipeline tests: 20+ material × machine × operation combinations
steps: Test matrix — materials: 4140 Steel, 316L Stainless, Ti-6Al-4V, 7075-T6 Aluminum, Inconel 718, PEEK, Cast Iron
Test matrix — machines: Haas VF-2 (3-axis), DMG DMU 50 (5-axis), Mazak QTN (lathe), Okuma LB3000 (mill-turn)
Test matrix — operations: facing, profiling, pocketing, drilling, tapping, 3D contouring, 5-axis simultaneous
Each test: run full pipeline from raw toolpath → optimized G-code → verification
Verify: G-code parses without errors per controller dialect
Verify: all S/F values within machine limits
Verify: all moves within machine work volume
Verify: chip thinning compensation active for light engagements
Verify: corner feed reduction active at direction changes
Verify: stability lobe RPM selection avoids chatter zones
Verify: analytics report generated with realistic values
Verify: setup sheet complete with all tool/operation data
Verify: cycle time estimate reasonable (within 20% of hand calculation)
Golden file tests: store reference outputs, regression check on future changes
exit_conditions: 20+ material/machine/operation combinations tested
All generated G-code passes PostProcessorVerificationEngine
No safety violations in any test case
Golden file regression suite established
100+ integration tests total

units.title: Optimization benchmarking: PRISM vs constant S/F baseline
steps: For each integration test case, generate TWO outputs:
A) Constant S/F: single S and F per tool (traditional post processor behavior)
B) PRISM optimized: full 35-stage pipeline variable S/F
Measure and compare:
Cycle time: PRISM should be 10-30% faster due to higher feeds in light engagement zones
Force variation: PRISM should show 30-50% less peak force variation (smoother cutting)
Tool life prediction: PRISM should predict 15-40% longer tool life due to wear-aware derating
Surface finish prediction: PRISM should predict better Ra consistency due to adaptive feed
Process capability: PRISM Cpk should be higher due to deflection compensation
Generate benchmark report with before/after metrics for each test case
Aggregate: average improvement across all test cases
Store benchmark results for marketing/documentation
exit_conditions: Benchmark report generated for all integration test cases
PRISM shows measurable improvement in at least 4 of 5 metrics
No test case where PRISM produces WORSE results than constant S/F
Aggregate improvement numbers documented

units.title: Slash commands: /post-process, /post-optimize, /post-configure, /post-benchmark
steps: Create /post-process skill: interactive full pipeline via MCP chat
Prompts for: material, machine, operation type, tool(s), tolerances
Accepts G-code paste or file path
Runs pp_run_full action, returns optimized G-code + summary report
Create /post-optimize skill: Phase B re-optimization of existing G-code
Accepts G-code paste/file + material/machine context
Returns before/after comparison with improvement metrics
Create /post-configure skill: configure pipeline stages and preferences
Interactive stage enable/disable
Set default machine, material, aggressiveness
Save as named profile for reuse
Create /post-benchmark skill: run optimization benchmark on sample programs
Uses built-in test cases to demonstrate PRISM optimization impact
Generates formatted benchmark report
exit_conditions: All 4 skills functional and documented in /commands list
Skills handle missing inputs gracefully (prompt for required, default for optional)
Output is formatted and actionable

units.title: Hooks: auto-optimize on G-code generation, warn on manual S/F, post-validation guard
steps: Hookify rule: autofire-post-optimize — when /program-gen or /gcode generates output, auto-run optimization
Hookify rule: warn-constant-sf — warn when G-code has same S/F for entire tool section
Hookify rule: post-validate-guard — auto-run verification after any G-code generation
Hookify rule: post-machine-match — warn when G-code contains codes not in selected controller dialect
Hook: posttooluse — if camDispatcher returns G-code, include optimization improvement estimate
Hook: pretooluse — if user requests G-code for a machine, auto-load machine profile from catalog
exit_conditions: Auto-optimize hook fires after /program-gen
Constant S/F warning fires for traditional G-code
Validation runs automatically after generation
All hooks registered in hookify system

units.title: Final dispatcher wiring + action schema + documentation

Wire ALL new engines to appropriate dispatchers:
PostProcessorPipelineEngine → camDispatcher (pp_run_full, pp_run_partial, pp_analyze, pp_configure, pp_reoptimize)

FiveAxisPostEngine → camDispatcher (five_axis_post, five_axis_tcpc, five_axis_linearize)
PostProcessorVerificationEngine → camDispatcher (pp_verify, pp_backplot, pp_grammar_check)
MachineSequenceEngine → camDispatcher (machine_sequence_startup, machine_sequence_toolchange)
MultiChannelPostEngine → camDispatcher (multi_channel_post, mill_turn_post)
Wire HTTP API actions to same engine instances (shared logic)
Update ToolRouter with new patterns for post processor actions
Update SYSTEM_INVENTORY.md with all new engines and actions
Update ENGINE_DIGEST.md with one-line descriptions
Update DISPATCHER_DIGEST.md with new action counts
Update CODE_SYSTEM_INDEX with DSL shortcodes for new files
exit_conditions: All new engines wired to dispatchers
All actions callable through dispatcher system
ToolRouter routes post-processor queries correctly
